// Blood II's weapons, every value retail ships: the reference for a mod's
// Mod\Weapons.txt. GENERATED by `testBlood2Tables --dump weapons` from
// Blood2/Shared/WeaponDefs.cpp; do not edit, regenerate. testBlood2Tables
// proves that loading this file as a mod changes nothing.
//
// A mod names only what it changes:
//
//     [BERETTA]
//     MinDamage = 16.0
//     MaxDamage = 24.0
//
// A section is the weapon's WEAP_ name (Shared/SharedDefs.h) without
// the prefix; the creature weapons are in the table too.  In
// HandModel, HandSkin, ProjectileClass, AltProjectileClass, StatusIcon
// and StatusIconH, "" means none (NULL: a ProjectileClass of "" is a
// vector weapon).  FireType is RIFLE, AUTORIFLE, PISTOL, MELEE or MAGIC;
// AmmoType one of AMMO_'s names.  Every number is 0 or more; a string
// is at most 99 characters. A section naming no weapon adds one on a Base
// (Blood2/Shared/BloodModWeapons.h).
